facts.fact: According to Brent Veazey's discussion of referral guilt among SMBs (cited by Adwave), 68% of SMBs hesitate to ask for referrals due to perceived awkwardness.
facts.quote: 68% of SMBs hesitate to ask due to perceived awkwardness, yet 82% of clients would refer if asked confidently after a win

facts.fact: Adwave describes a three-part referral ask formula: affirm the relationship, plant the seed, then make a direct no-pressure ask.
facts.quote: affirm the relationship, plant the seed, then make a direct no-pressure ask

facts.fact: Adwave's base script for the final step of the referral ask is "Who comes to mind that might appreciate the same kind of help?"
facts.quote: Who comes to mind that might appreciate the same kind of help?

facts.fact: The Adwave article was published on July 5, 2026.
According to Southwestern Consulting, asking for pre-approach details too quickly causes 80% of people to stop at one referral.
facts.quote: asking for pre-approach details too quickly causes **80% to stop at one referral**

facts.fact: According to Southwestern Consulting, asking "Who else?" after securing a name and writing down as much information as possible can lead to 10 or more contacts.
facts.quote: asking **“Who else?”** after securing the name and writing down as much information as possible can lead to **10+ contacts**

facts.fact: According to Southwestern Consulting, 70% of new business comes from existing referral sources who have referred in the past year.
facts.quote: **70% of new business comes from existing referral sources who have referred in the past year**

facts.fact: According to Southwestern Consulting, nurturing referral relationships has been shown to accelerate client growth by 150% in five weeks.
facts.quote: nurturing those relationships has been shown to **accelerate client growth by 150% in five weeks**

facts.fact: The article advises that a short non-pushy referral follow-up should be sent a few days after a prospect says they will think about it.
